visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black beanie and a colorful striped cardigan stands in a dimly lit exhibition hall. Behind him is a massive animatronic T-Rex with detailed skin textures in red, grey, and blue. The dinosaur moves its head and opens its mouth as the man points towards it while looking at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor entrance area with a large yellow sign featuring dinosaur graphics. A ticket price board is visible near a window. The man poses briefly outside the venue before the shot transitions back indoors. (3) Inside, the man interacts with a long-necked dinosaur animatronic, holding a long pole with green leaves to mimic feeding. The dinosaur's head descends towards him with realistic motion. He reacts with a surprised facial expression. (4) Close-up shots show informational panels with text about the Titanosaur. The man stands next to a replica of a giant dinosaur leg bone, showcasing its scale compared to his body. The lighting is a mix of orange and red spotlights. (5) He explores a large hall filled with dinosaur skeletons, including a massive long-necked sauropod and various theropods. The skeletons are illuminated with dramatic red and purple lights. He touches the teeth of a large theropod skull. (6) The man interacts with a touch-screen display showing dinosaur anatomy and reaches into a circular opening of a model to feel its internal texture. (7) He returns to the large T-Rex animatronic, which lunges its head forward. The man performs a scared reaction, crouching slightly as the dinosaur opens its mouth wide towards the lens.

(6) [Slogan]: 來自大英博物館的 泰坦恐龍. (7) [Slogan]: 還有掠食者的頭骨. (8) [Slogan]: 可以拍照 順便跟恐龍的腸胃互動... (9) [Slogan]: 超霸氣的等比例暴龍.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young man with shoulder-length black hair wearing a black beanie, a multicolored striped cardigan (purple, yellow, green, white), black pants, and a green crossbody bag.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Mainly indoor museum exhibition halls with high black ceilings, exposed ventilation pipes, dramatic colored lighting (red, purple, orange, blue), large dinosaur animatronics, articulated skeletons, informational text panels, and interactive digital kiosks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat acoustic pop music featuring guitar strumming and a steady drum beat. A male narrator speaks clearly in Mandarin with a casual tone. A loud, guttural mechanical roar (T-Rex) with low-frequency resonance interrupts the speech. (2) The narrator's voice is overlaid on the music as he describes the exhibition. Faint indoor room tone and distant echoes from the large hall are present. (3) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a scene transition. The speaker's pitch rises with excitement during the feeding interaction. (4) Distinct mechanical whirring sounds are heard under the narration, timed with the movement of the large dinosaur animatronics. (5) Another dinosaur roar, higher in pitch and sharp in texture, occurs as the camera zooms in on a different model. Background chatter from children is audible. (6) The pop music continues as the main layer, with the narrator explaining facts about the Titanosaur. The spectral brightness remains balanced. (7) A sequence of three powerful, aggressive roars and growls dominate the audio track. The narrator lets out a humorous, high-pitched gasp in response to the T-Rex lunging, followed by a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A lifestyle vlog intended to showcase the 'Titanosaur' exhibition at the National Taiwan Science Education Center. The creator uses a mix of educational information, interactive demonstrations, and humorous reactions to encourage viewers to visit the event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes dynamic lighting and animatronic sound effects to create an immersive atmosphere. The editing pace is well-matched to the upbeat music.
